title: A hidden page control with written words is kept; any other hidden link takes its written label with it
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A form submit (page-control) the plan hid while writing its label ends in the decision's links with its label, not hidden.
A hidden navigation link's written label is hidden; a label another block owns stays written.

tests: a hidden page control whose words the decision writes is kept; any other hidden link takes its written label with it
